about.title: About Us
about.body:
Nur Quran is a free website and app that helps Muslims around the world read and learn the Holy Quran and keep up with their daily worship.

## What you can do with Nur Quran
- Read the full Quran in several fonts and themes
- Listen to recitation by well-known reciters, ayah by ayah
- Read translations and tafsir
- See prayer times for your city and find the Qibla direction
- Count dhikr with the Tasbeeh counter
- Learn Tajweed step by step

## Our mission
Our aim is to make the Quran easy to read, listen to and understand for everyone, in their own language, on any device.

## Contact us
If you have a question, a suggestion or find a mistake, please write to us at: [your contact email]

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
This Privacy Policy explains how Nur Quran (the "app" or "website"), made by NurBuy, handles your information. By using the app you agree to this policy.

## Information we collect
We do not ask you to create an account, and we do not collect your name, phone number or email address.

- Settings: your chosen Quran font, theme, reciter, reading position, Tasbeeh counts and similar preferences are saved only on your own device (in the browser or app storage). They are not sent to us.
- Location: if you allow it, your device location is used only to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction on your device. You can instead pick your city by hand. We do not store or share your location.
- Premium codes: if you redeem a Premium code, the code and a random device ID created by the app are sent to our server, so the code works only on your device. This ID does not identify you personally.
- Technical data: like any website, our server may briefly record basic technical information such as your IP address and browser type to keep the service safe and working. This is not used to identify you.

## How we use information
We use the information above only to run the app's features, to prevent abuse and to improve the service. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising.

## Third-party services
Some content, such as Quran audio and tafsir text, is loaded from trusted third-party sources (for example GitHub and the Quran.com API). These services may receive your IP address when the content is loaded, under their own privacy policies.

## Notifications
If you allow notifications, they are used only for prayer time alerts and app news. You can turn them off at any time in your device settings.

## Data security and deletion
Most of your data never leaves your device. You can delete it at any time by clearing the app's data or your browser storage, or by uninstalling the app. To ask us to delete a Premium code record linked to your device, contact us at the email below.

## Children
The app is suitable for all ages and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

## Changes to this policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page, with the date it was last updated.

## Contact us
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: [your contact email]
